title: Getting Started
useWhen: You want to run, host or develop MATHALOID Atlas.
summary: Run the app from a folder, a local server or GitHub Pages; manage your data; build the docs.
plaintext: Requirements MATHALOID Atlas is a static site with zero runtime packages . Any modern browser works. Install Bun 1.3.14 or newer to run the local server, rebuild documentation and execute contributor checks; package installation is unnecessary for this dependency free application. Optional real browser verification requires an installed Playwright tooling module. On Windows it uses Node for Playwright's browser transport, invoked through bun run test:browser or bun run test:renderer:browser . The application and its normal contributor tooling run with Bun. Run it locally Option A — just open it: Option B — tiny local server recommended, matches production paths : Deploy to GitHub Pages 1. Push the repository to GitHub. 2. Settings → Pages → deploy from the main branch, root folder. 3. Done — there is no build pipeline to configure. The docs portal ships pre built at /docs/index.html . Your data All progress is stored under the localStorage key atlas.state.v1 older mathbot.state.v1 saves migrate automatically . Export / erase from Settings at any time. Clearing browser data resets everything — by design there is no cloud copy. Developer commands Where to go next Architecture architecture.md — how the three JS modules fit together. Contributing contributing.md — the safe change workflow.
